battle.name: 蔡州之戰
battle.brief: 元和十二年（817）冬，唐將李愬率唐鄧軍冒雪自文城疾行六十里，直抵淮西節度使吳元濟老巢蔡州（治今河南汝南），內應李祐開門，牙城一日而破，吳元濟騎驢至城濠被擒。攻城序列中弩兵居中樞：連發之弩壓制城頭、掩護鵬車進逼，並在暗削之城坡上向城內射擊，是破城與雪夜奇襲都離不開的定點火力。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 秦連弩是中國古代陸軍弩類射手裝備，配置於步軍，負責連續射擊與定點火力壓制，在遠程兵器體系中用於持續支援。

countries: 蔡州之戰是唐憲宗元和十二年（817）平定淮西藩鎮的圍城決戰，交戰一方是唐廷與淮西節度使吳元濟的割據軍，另一方是自河南、山南、江淮各道調來的官軍以及李愬所領的唐鄧軍。淮西軍以蔡州城為巢穴，治所在今河南汝南，節制申州、光州等州縣，憑堅城、堡柵與州縣據點自守，十餘年截斷朝廷的任命與賦稅；吳少陽死後吳元濟秘不發喪、拒交節度使兵權，朝廷詔令諸道討平。行營置宣慰處置使裴度總制各道客軍，屯紮汝州、鄧州、襄州一線，糧秣自江淮沿汴水轉輸，後勤據於汴、汝之間的城鎮。真正執行奇襲的是唐鄧軍，以李愬為節度使，骨幹是自鄂岳調來的邊防精兵與收編的降卒，另有河中、昭義、曲沃等處奉詔出兵的部眾。河北成德王廷湊奉詔助軍，淄青李師道表面順從而暗中觀望，甚至接濟叛軍，構成外圍變數。兩軍總實力懸殊，唐廷取勝靠的並非人數，而是避開正面強攻、以奇兵夜襲直取城心的戰法。
countriesEn: The Battle of Caizhou was the siege that decided the fate of the Huaixi circuit in the twelfth year of the Yuanhe era, 817. One side was the Tang court together with the separatist army of Huaixi jiedushi Wu Yuanji; the other was the imperial troops mustered from Henan, Shannan, Jiangnan and the Huai region, plus the Tang-Deng army commanded by Li Su. The Huaixi forces used the walled city of Caizhou, the circuit seat at present-day Runan in Henan, as their lair, and controlled the prefectures of Shen and Guang, holding the strong walls, forts and prefectural strongholds to defend themselves; for more than a decade they had cut the court off from appointments and taxation. After Wu Shaoyang died, Wu Yuanji concealed the news, seized all authority, and refused to hand over the circuit command; the court then ordered several circuits to move against him. The field headquarters was placed under Pei Du as Commissioner for Pacification and Settlement, commanding the contingents sent in by the various circuits, with the main body encamped along the line of Yuzhou, Dengzhou and Xiangzhou and with grain and materiel ferried north from Jianghuai and staged in the towns between Bian and Ru. The force that actually carried out the raid was the Tang-Deng army under Li Su: its backbone was the picked frontier troops transferred from E-Yue together with surrendered men folded into the ranks, reinforced by detachments from Pingyang, Zhaoyi and Quwo. Chengde under Wang Tingcong sent troops as ordered, while Ziqing under Li Shidao pretended to obey while watching from the sidelines and even aided the rebels, making them the peripheral variable of the campaign. The two sides were grossly mismatched in overall strength, and what decided the Tang victory was not numbers but method: avoid frontal siege, and drive a night raid straight at the heart of the city.
people: 核心人物是李愬。憲宗以檢校鄧州刺史兼唐州刺史李愬接替袁滋出任唐鄧節度使，因為袁滋入淮西軍後逗留百日、只求安撫而不敢進兵。李愬到軍後整汰老弱、收容降卒、奏請增兵，選出精銳數千，一改前軍畏縮之態；又用護糧與反間之計擊敗截道的敵軍，顯示其長於奇謀。內應李祐出身叛軍，與吳元濟有血緣，卻在雪夜決戰前夜倒戈，舉火為號開啟牙城一門，是奇襲成敗的關鍵。居中持重的是總制行營的裴度，處置降人、安撫州縣，事後接手收束淮西善後。守方主帥吳元濟是淮西節度使吳少陽之子，他拒絕交出兵權、秘不發喪，終以孤城自守直至城破。攻城器械方面，兩軍都倚重匠人：吳元濟造器械大營鵬城，李愬攻破後奪得通鑑所載的器械匠吳通，得其技藝而改造攻城用的鵬車。蔡州之役後李愬進封邠國公、拜檢校右僕射，翌年病卒，年五十六；戰功遂由裴度以穩健手腕收拾。
peopleEn: The central figure was Li Su. Because Yuan Zi had entered the Huaixi army and then lingered there for a hundred days, asking only for pacification and unwilling to advance, the emperor appointed Li Su, who held the posts of Inspector of Dengzhou and concurrently Prefect of Tangzhou, as military governor of Tang-Deng. On taking command Li Su weeded out the old and weak, took in surrendered men, petitioned for more troops and selected several thousand of the best, changing the army from paralysis to purpose. He also broke the enemy force that cut the supply road, using the tactics of escorting grain and sowing dissension, which showed a mind skilled in unexpected moves. The insider Li You came out of the rebel army and was related to Wu Yuanji by blood, yet turned against him on the eve of the snowy night, raising fire as the signal to open one gate of the inner city; that single act decided whether the raid would succeed. Pei Du, who directed the field headquarters from the centre, kept a steady hand, settling the surrendered and reassuring the prefectures, and afterwards took over the cleanup of Huaixi. On the defending side, the commander Wu Yuanji was the son of Huaixi jiedushi Wu Shaoyang; he refused to surrender the military command, concealed his father's death, and held out in the isolated city until it fell. Both sides leaned heavily on engineers: Wu Yuanji built the great instrument depot known as the Peng city, and after Li Su stormed it he seized the instrument-maker Wu You whom the Zizhi Tongjian records, and used his skill to rebuild and improve the Peng siege engine. After the campaign Li Su was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin and made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; he fell ill and died the following year at the age of fifty-six, and Pei Du carried the credit of the victory onward with steadier hands.
kits: 卡面的秦連弩出自戰國秦國的弩機工藝：一具弩機上裝有可連發的連弩匣，匣內預儲數十支矢，扣動機括即可次第射出，單兵便能維持長時間連續射擊，適合定點壓制、封鎖通道與近距離持續支援。蔡州攻戰的史籍並不逐一記錄每件兵器，但弩兵確是圍城與強攻的骨幹火力。李愬軍中弩具，唐代兵書《太白陰經》所錄以蹶張弩、角弓、羃弩等為主，形制早已與秦連弩分作兩路；連發機括雖早失傳於實物，匣儲箭矢、以機括次第擊發的原理仍留在各式弩具之中。攻城序列之中弩手的任務極具體：以交叉火力封鎖城門、壓制城頭弓手，掩護巨型攻城器械鵬車進逼城牆，在削城階段更由築於土坡上的弩手居高向城內射擊，把守軍壓得抬不起頭。李愬依器械匠吳通改造的鵬車用以撞擊城角，城中守軍則以鵬城所造撞車、雲梯、鉤城、火箭及配重木製攻城塔相抗。野戰與護糧用騎兵與步卒，長槍、陌刀、櫓盾、拒馬槊、柴車與皮排協同。糧秣、箭矢與甲兵依賴汴汝之間的陸運車隊，攻城所耗木石、柴薪與火料亦須自後方轉運補足。
kitsEn: The card's Qin repeating crossbow comes from the crossbow-lock engineering of the Warring States kingdom of Qin: a repeating magazine is fitted to the lock, dozens of bolts are stored inside it, and pulling the mechanism fires them one after another, so a single man can keep up sustained fire. That makes it ideal for suppressing a fixed point, sealing a passage and giving close support over a long period. The chronicles of the siege do not list every weapon in turn, but the crossbowmen were the backbone of both the blockade and the assault. The crossbows of Li Su's army were of the types recorded in the Tang military manual Taibai Yinjing, chief among them the strong-drawn crossbow, the horn bow and the bamboo-and-wood crossbow, forms that had already diverged from the Qin repeating crossbow; the repeating mechanism itself had long ceased to exist as an artefact, yet the principle of storing bolts in a magazine and releasing them by a mechanism survived in every crossbow family. The task of the crossbowmen in the siege sequence was very specific: to seal the gates with crossfire, to pin down the archers on the wall, to screen the huge siege engine, the Peng cart, as it advanced against the curtain wall, and in the phase of shaving the wall, to station crossbowmen on the earthen ramp they had raised so that they could shoot down into the city and keep the defenders from lifting their heads. Li Su had the Peng cart rebuilt from the design of the instrument-maker Wu You to ram the corner of the wall, while the defenders answered with the rams, ladders, grappling hooks, fire arrows and counterweighted wooden siege towers built inside the Peng depot. In the field and on escort duty the army used cavalry and foot, with long spears, dao blades, shields, horse-denying stakes, firewood carts and hide-covered waggons working together. Grain, arrows and armour travelled by the land convoys between Bian and Ru, and the timber, stone, firewood and kindling consumed by the siege works had to be hauled forward from the rear as well.
tactics: 蔡州之戰的戰法由三段構成：先斷糧道，再破外郭，最後夜襲城心。斷糧一段，李愬派輕騎護送糧車，擊潰吳元濟派來截糧的精兵，又以委載轉運、委棄示弱等計，使守軍誤判官軍糧道已絕；破外郭一段，先取洄曲與張柴村，再攻器械大營鵬城，繳獲攻城器械並奪得匠人，繼而仿造改進鵬車撞擊城角，因死傷過眾而暫止；暗削一段，李愬秘令死士穿溝於城外積土成坡，令弩手登坡向城內射箭，佯作築城而不令守方察覺，歷時數十日把城頭削平至羊馬城高，與守軍只隔一堞。雪夜一段，唐軍將士不舉火把、不擊鼓角，各帶乾糧自文城出發，冒大雪行六十里至蔡州城下，先焚鵬寨與城樓，同時在牙城一面由內應李祐開門，內外夾擊而城破。關鍵不在硬攻，而在保密、節奏與時機：朝廷曾下詔赦免吳元濟並許和，李愬秘而不宣，等到守軍糧盡勢窮，再以一夜雪幕完成總攻。
tacticsEn: The method of the campaign at Caizhou had three movements: first cut the grain road, then break the outer works, and finally raid the heart of the city in the night. In the first movement Li Su sent light cavalry to escort the grain wagons, broke the elite troops Wu Yuanji had sent to intercept the convoys, and used feints such as abandoning loads and disguising convoys as empty to make the defenders believe the imperial supply line had already been cut. In the second he took Hiuiqu and Zhangchai village first, then assaulted the great instrument depot, the Peng city, capturing siege machines and taking the craftsmen prisoner; he then rebuilt the Peng cart in an improved form and rammed the corner of the wall, and stopped because the cost in dead was too great. In the third, done in secret, Li Su had picked men dig trenches outside the wall and pile up earth to form a ramp, then posted crossbowmen on it to shoot into the city, passing it off as fortification work so that the defenders would not notice; over several tens of days the wall head was shaved down level with the low outer wall, leaving only a single parapet between the ramp and the defenders. In the snowy night itself, the Tang soldiers carried no torches, sounded no drums, took their dry rations with them and left Wencheng in silence, covering some sixty li in the great snow to reach the foot of the wall before dawn; they first fired the Peng depot and the tower above the gate, and at the same moment the insider Li You opened a gate of the inner city, so that the city fell between the two attacks. The key was not a frontal assault but secrecy, tempo and timing: the court had already issued a pardon to Wu Yuanji and allowed terms, but Li Su kept the edict back, waited until the defenders were out of grain and out of hope, and then delivered the final blow under cover of a single night of snow.
data: 有據可考的數字多來自《資治通鑑》與唐史的零星記載。戰事自元和十二年七月朝廷易帥起，至十一月城破，前後約四個月，其中圍城與器械攻伐占三個多月。雪夜行軍的距離是自文城行六十里，約合三十餘公里，士卒不舉火、不鳴鼓、不食乾糧而行，抵城下已是天明。削城工程歷時數十日，投入死士數百人。奏請增兵一項，朝廷另給精兵數千，李愬因此得以汰弱留強、繕造器械。攻城期間的損失雖無確數，但史料明記鵬車撞城之後死者甚眾，因而中止；城中糧秣亦在圍城期內耗盡，迫使吳元濟遣使請和。破城當日，吳元濟單騎出走至城壕，馬陷泥中，為追騎擒獲。淮西既定，朝廷隨即著手補州縣缺官、選禁軍分鎮各州，並令整點戶籍、籍定軍賦，以補戰後之空缺。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on come from the scattered entries in the Zizhi Tongjian and in the Tang histories. The business ran from the change of commander in the seventh month of the twelfth year of Yuanhe to the fall of the city in the eleventh month, some four months in all, of which the blockade and the works against the walls occupied more than three. The distance covered in the snowy night march was the sixty li from Wencheng, roughly thirty kilometres, the soldiers marching without torches, without drums and without eating, and reaching the walls at daybreak. The work of shaving the wall took several tens of days and employed several hundred picked men. On Li Su's petition for reinforcements the court granted several thousand more troops, which allowed him to discard the weak, keep the strong and repair his equipment. The losses during the siege are not exactly recorded, but the histories state plainly that after the Peng cart struck the wall the dead were so numerous that the assault was halted; the grain inside the city was also exhausted within the months of the blockade, which forced Wu Yuanji to send an envoy to ask for terms. On the day the city fell, Wu Yuanji rode out alone, his horse sank in the mud of the moat, and he was taken by the pursuing cavalry. Once Huaixi was settled, the court set about filling the vacancies in the prefectures, choosing imperial guards to garrison the several prefectures, and ordering a fresh register of households and of the military levy, to make good the gaps left by the war.
cause: 蔡州之戰的起因，要從淮西藩鎮的割據說起。吳少誠於元和九年（814）據淮西抗命，朝廷姑且授其子吳少陽為節度使以羈縻；史載吳少陽曾與朝廷議歸順而未及成行，淮西自此十餘年不貢賦、不受節制，擁兵自重，節制申、光等州，朝廷的任命與轉運屢屢受阻。元和十二年（817）四月吳少陽病死，吳元濟秘不發喪、盡收其權，拒絕朝廷所遣的新任節度使袁滋入軍，並驅逐朝廷使者，淮西與中央的矛盾由拖延轉為公開對抗。憲宗乃罷袁滋，改命唐鄧節度使李愬專責討平；同時詔令成德、淄青、義武、河中、昭義等道出兵助攻，並以加授節度使、賜鐵券、進鹽鐵使等名位羈縻北方藩鎮，藉以孤立淮西。吳元濟倚仗蔡州堅城與器械之利，欲據淮西以自保；李愬所部則面對持久圍城、糧道受襲與士氣低落的困局，遂以奇襲求速決。
causeEn: The causes of the Battle of Caizhou run back to the separatism of the Huaixi circuit. In the ninth year of Yuanhe, 814, Wu Shaocheng rose in arms at Huaixi, and the court made the best of a bad job by granting the circuit to his son Wu Shaoyang as a way of holding him; the histories record that Wu Shaoyang once entered into negotiations with the court about submitting but never carried it through. Huaixi therefore paid no taxes and obeyed no orders for more than a decade, kept troops of its own, held the prefectures of Shen and Guang, and repeatedly blocked the court's appointments and its remittances. In the fourth month of the twelfth year of Yuanhe, 817, Wu Shaoyang died; Wu Yuanji concealed the death, took all power to himself, refused to admit Yuan Zi, the newly appointed circuit governor sent by the court, and drove away the court's envoys, so that the quarrel between Huaixi and the centre changed from delay into open armed opposition. The emperor therefore dismissed Yuan Zi and charged Li Su, military governor of Tang-Deng, with the task of reducing Huaixi; at the same time he ordered the circuits of Chengde, Ziqing, Yiwu, Pingyang, Zhaoyi and others to send troops to the campaign, and tied down the northern feudatories with the bait of extra titles, iron certificates of pardon and control of the salt and iron monopolies, in order to isolate Huaixi. Wu Yuanji meant to hold on to Huaixi by means of the strong city of Caizhou and its siege works; Li Su's army, for its part, faced a protracted blockade, a supply road under attack and low morale, and so sought a swift decision by surprise.
impact: 蔡州陷落是元和削藩的一個節點，也是一個限度。淮西重鎮歸順，吳元濟押解京師、斬於獨柳之下，淮西節度使改由降將李祐接任，唐廷重新取得淮西一帶的人事與賦稅，朝議與士氣為之一振；李愬以功進封邠國公、拜檢校右僕射，數月後病卒，善後由裴度接手。局勢卻未因此徹底改變：降將李祐在數年後再度起兵，淮西再亂，直至裴度出兵才再度平定；河北的成德、淄青等鎮表面歸順而實則自若，憲宗一旦去世，割據勢力迅速反彈。因此蔡州之戰的意義，一方面在於證明唐廷仍具備野戰與攻城的技術能力，李愬雪夜六十里的突進與連續月餘的器械攻伐，後世兵家講到夜襲與內應仍常援引為例；另一方面也在於暴露以暫時合縱取代制度性整合的隱憂：一座城的陷落可以改變一兩個州的歸屬，卻改不了一套節度使體制本身的運作邏輯。
impactEn: The fall of Caizhou was both a milestone and a limit in the Yuanhe-era campaign against the feudatories. The great circuit of Huaixi came back to the fold: Wu Yuanji was escorted to the capital and beheaded beneath the Duli tree, the circuit was handed to the surrendered general Li You, and the court recovered control of appointments and revenue across Huaixi; court opinion and morale rose accordingly. Li Su was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin and made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and died of illness a few months later, with Pei Du taking over the aftermath. Yet nothing was truly settled. The surrendered Li You rose again some years afterwards, Huaixi flared up a second time and was only put down when Pei Du took the field. The northern circuits of Chengde and Ziqing went through the motions of obedience while remaining masters of their own ground, and once the emperor died the separatist forces rebounded quickly. The significance of the Battle of Caizhou therefore lay on two levels. It demonstrated that the Tang state still possessed the technical capacity to fight in the field and to conduct a siege, and Li Su's sixty-li march through the snow, with weeks of patient work against the walls, became a standing example in later military writing on night raids and insiders. At the same time it exposed the weakness of substituting a temporary coalition of feudatories for real institutional integration: the fall of a single city could change the allegiance of one or two prefectures, but it could not change the working logic of the circuit system itself.
result: 元和十二年十一月十七日夜，蔡州城破。李愬命人焚燒鵬寨與城樓，同時在牙城一面發動突擊，內應李祐開門放入唐軍，吳元濟單騎騎驢出走至城壕，為追騎擒獲，淮西軍主力隨之瓦解。吳元濟與一批將佐被押送京師，次年斬於獨柳之下，屍首懸於城門示眾。破城之後，李愬分遣官員巡行州縣，接收城鎮、封存府庫、安置降卒與器械，並留軍鎮守，一場延續四年的淮西之亂至此平定。對唐憲宗而言，這是一場值得記取的勝利：藩鎮中號稱地險的淮西終於歸順，元和中興的聲望為之一振；對淮西當地而言，割據勢力被連根拔除，州縣重歸朝廷版籍，之後數年因李祐再叛而再受兵禍。李愬以雪夜六十里的突進、連續月餘的器械攻伐與一次內應取勝，寫下唐代戰史上極為罕見的城市奇襲；他本人不久病卒，戰功由裴度以穩健手腕收束，其名則列入唐史將相列傳與後世兵家口耳。
resultEn: On the night of the seventeenth day of the eleventh month of the twelfth year of Yuanhe, the city of Caizhou fell. Li Su ordered the Peng depot and the tower above the gate fired, and at the same moment launched an assault on one side of the inner city, where the insider Li You opened the gate and let the Tang troops in; Wu Yuanji rode out alone on a donkey to the moat, was taken by the pursuing cavalry, and the main body of the Huaixi army broke up with him. Wu Yuanji and a number of his commanders were escorted to the capital and beheaded beneath the Duli tree the following year, his corpse displayed at the city gate. After the city fell, Li Su sent officers out through the prefectures to take over the towns, seal the treasuries, settle the surrendered men and the captured equipment, and left troops to garrison what had been taken; thus ended the Huaixi revolt that had run for four years. For Emperor Xianzong this was a victory worth recording: Huaixi, the circuit famed for the strength of its terrain, finally submitted, and the reputation of the Yuanhe revival rose with it. For Huaixi itself the separatist power was torn out by the roots, the prefectures returned to the court's registers, and the region was to suffer warfare once more in later years when Li You rebelled a second time. Li Su had won with a sixty-li march through the snow, weeks of patient work against the walls and a single act of treason from within, producing one of the rarest city raids in Tang military history. He fell ill and died shortly afterwards, the credit of the victory was closed out by Pei Du with steadier hands, and his name entered the biographies of generals and ministers in the Tang histories and the talk of later military writers.
